message.content: {"note_claim":"The tanker was flying a false flag, giving the French navy the right to board it under international law.","label":"SUPPORTS","quote":"La Marine française a estimé qu’il s’agissait probablement d’un faux pavillon, et a décidé de monter à bord du navire, comme le permet la convention de Montego Bay sur le droit de la mer.","reason":"The article directly states that France considered the flag probably false and boarded under authority it attributes to the law-of-the-sea convention."}

parsed.note_claim: The tanker was flying a false flag, giving the French navy the right to board it under international law.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: La Marine française a estimé qu’il s’agissait probablement d’un faux pavillon, et a décidé de monter à bord du navire, comme le permet la convention de Montego Bay sur le droit de la mer.
parsed.reason: The article directly states that France considered the flag probably false and boarded under authority it attributes to the law-of-the-sea convention.
